desc: Although extremely effective, slugs deliver a fair amount of recoil. Now, hunters have an alternative with the new SST Lite Shotgun Slug. This load is ideal for youngsters, women or anyone looking to tame the recoil of their rifled barrel slug gun- offering 40% less felt recoil compared to standard 12 gauge options. Loaded with the same 300 grain FTX projectile used in the original SST Slug, the SST Lite leaves the muzzle at 1575 fps, but is a mild recoiling load capable of taking the largest Midwest whitetail out to 150 yards!
